criteria.label: One-command immutable code rollback
criteria.description: Reverts production traffic to an earlier immutable build or revision without rebuilding from Git source.

criteria.label: Pre-traffic migration / release command
criteria.description: Native release or pre-deploy command runs database migrations before live traffic shifts to the new build.

criteria.label: Default canary with automatic 5xx rollback
criteria.description: Progressive traffic shift enabled by default that automatically aborts and rolls back on elevated 5xx errors.

criteria.label: Managed PostgreSQL point-in-time recovery
criteria.description: Continuous WAL archiving enabling timestamped restore of managed PostgreSQL databases.

criteria.label: Coordinated code + Postgres rollback together
criteria.description: Single coordinated operation that reverts application code alongside managed PostgreSQL to that release's point in time.

criteria.label: Config / env-var rollback tied to release
criteria.description: Environment variables and runtime configuration are snapshotted per release and restored automatically when rolling back.

criteria.label: Built-in release freezes & approval gates
criteria.description: First-party release freeze windows and human production approval gates enforced server-side before promotion.

criteria.label: Artifact-digest staging -> prod promotion
criteria.description: Built-in promotion of the verified immutable artifact digest from staging to production without rebuilding.
